mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4% signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the unemployment rate below 9.5% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting improved labor market conditions and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such periods are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in the federal funds rate below 4% and unemployment rate below 9.5% signal an expansionary monetary and labor market environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to exceed baseline in 60% of triggered instances, or interaction effect rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 12,000 billion chained 2017 dollars signals robust demand growth, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or rank IC < 0.1 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% during a tightening cycle compresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent surges in GDP (GDPC1) above 13,000 billion chained 2017 dollars and declines in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 index points signal supply-demand imbalances, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to be significantly negative (p > 0.05) or interaction effect rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.0% signals upward price pressures, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in such periods are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or rank IC > 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 95 index points indicates expanding supply chains, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to exceed baseline in 70% of instances, or rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year window.
